## Teaching points

1. In an anuric dialysis patient, oxygen and ventilatory support buy time while the team arranges urgent dialysis for severe pulmonary edema.
2. Assess airway, work of breathing and ECG while urgently involving critical care and renal services. Oxygen saturation improvement does not remove excess volume.
3. The game has no dialysis or noninvasive ventilation order. Arrange definitive therapy through the handoff; do not interpret an oxygen response as definitive recovery.
